notes.title: The Announcement of the "Delivery Driver Service" game!
notes.notes:
Greetings dear players! 

Arkuda inc. team presents a new project “Delivery Driver Service”, in which you will have to help rebuild the state after the recent hurricane. The main game mechanics consists of delivery of various construction materials and not only.

There are several cars available in the game that vary in their class. Tuning is included so that you can efficiently move around the map, which was heavily damaged after the hurricane.

The player's actions directly affect the game world. As the map is rebuilt, new opportunities open up for the player.

The game has been in an active development phase for a long time, improving the gameplay for the better each time.

Don't forget to add the game to your “Wishlist”, it will let us see your interest in our game!
